title: FROM JOHN TO JESUS · The Witness · The Water · The Light

cards.title: A Voice in the Wilderness
cards.speaker: Narrator citing Scripture
cards.visual: An empty wilderness path opens toward John.

cards.title: John Appeared
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: Adult John stands beside the Jordan and begins proclaiming.

cards.title: Crowds at the Jordan
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: Crowds approach while John baptizes one person.

cards.title: Camel Hair and Wild Honey
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: John's rough garment, belt, locust, and honey are reduced to four simple motifs.

cards.title: The Stronger One Comes
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John points beyond himself toward an open path.

cards.title: Water and Spirit
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: A water line opens upward into one descending breath-like line.

cards.title: Jesus Comes to John
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: Jesus walks from the right toward John at the river.

cards.title: Baptized by John
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: John directly baptizes Jesus in the Jordan.

cards.title: Heavens Torn Open
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: Jesus rises from water beneath one torn vertical opening.

cards.title: You Are My Beloved Son
cards.speaker: Heavenly voice within narration
cards.visual: Jesus stands in still water; John witnesses nearby; no speaker figure.

cards.title: After John Was Handed Over
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: A prison door closes behind John as Jesus walks into Galilee.

cards.title: John Challenges Herod
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John faces a seated ruler without bowing.

cards.title: The Forerunner Is Killed
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: An empty prison, extinguished lamp, and disciples carrying a covered body; no gore.

cards.title: The Kingdom Has Drawn Near
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John proclaims beside a path shaped by one gold diamond marker.

cards.title: Judea Goes Out to John
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: A stream of compact figures moves toward the Jordan.

cards.title: Brood of Vipers
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John addresses religious leaders; one small snake-line remains symbolic.

cards.title: Fruit Worthy of Repentance
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: A living fruit branch stands beside an axe at a dead root.

cards.title: Spirit and Fire
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: Water below, a breath-line and one gold flame above.

cards.title: Winnowing Floor
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: Grain and chaff separate under a simple winnowing fork.

cards.title: Jesus Comes from Galilee
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: Jesus crosses open ground toward John's river.

cards.title: John Tries to Prevent Him
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John raises one hand in resistance before Jesus.

cards.title: Allow It Now
cards.speaker: Jesus
cards.visual: Jesus answers calmly; John lowers his raised hand.

cards.title: Spirit and Public Declaration
cards.speaker: Narrator / heavenly voice
cards.visual: John and Jesus in water beneath a descending dove-line.

cards.title: Are You the Coming One?
cards.speaker: John's messengers / Jesus
cards.visual: Two messengers ask Jesus while healing actions remain visible behind them.

cards.title: More Than a Prophet
cards.speaker: Jesus
cards.visual: After the messengers leave, Jesus turns to address the crowd about John.

cards.title: Death and Burial
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: John's disciples carry him away from the fortress; no banquet spectacle or gore.

cards.title: A Birth Is Announced
cards.speaker: Angelic messenger within narration
cards.visual: Zechariah receives the announcement in a minimal sanctuary space.

cards.title: His Name Is John
cards.speaker: Elizabeth / Zechariah / Narrator
cards.visual: A writing tablet states the naming through deterministic typography.

cards.title: Child of the Most High
cards.speaker: Zechariah / Narrator
cards.visual: The child stands at the edge of a widening wilderness path.

cards.title: The Word Comes in the Wilderness
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: John stands beneath a sparse ruler-and-region timeline.

cards.title: Fruit or the Axe
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John addresses the crowd beside fruit and root symbols.

cards.title: Share Clothing and Food
cards.speaker: Crowd / John the Baptist
cards.visual: One person passes a folded garment and bread to another.

cards.title: Collect No More
cards.speaker: Tax collectors / John the Baptist
cards.visual: A tax collector removes extra coins from a scale.

cards.title: Do Not Extort
cards.speaker: Soldiers / John the Baptist
cards.visual: A soldier lowers an accusing hand and returns a purse.

cards.title: Spirit, Fire, and Winnowing
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: Water, one flame, and grain form three restrained motifs.

cards.title: John Is Shut in Prison
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: John faces Herod; the next frame is a closed prison door.

cards.title: Jesus Is Baptized and Prays
cards.speaker: Narrator / heavenly voice
cards.visual: Jesus prays after baptism; the baptizer is unnamed in the frame.

cards.title: Tell John What You See
cards.speaker: John's messengers / Jesus
cards.visual: Healing actions answer the messengers' question.

cards.title: Jesus Evaluates John
cards.speaker: Jesus
cards.visual: The messengers depart; Jesus publicly names John's greatness.

cards.title: Not the Light · Witness to the Light
cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.visual: John holds a small lamp while a larger light remains beyond him.

cards.title: Who Are You?
cards.speaker: Questioners / John the Baptist
cards.visual: Delegates question John; he points away from himself.

cards.title: I Baptize with Water
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John stands in water while the unknown one is represented only by an open space.

cards.title: Behold the Lamb of God
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John points toward Jesus; one small lamb symbol remains separate from the historical scene.

cards.title: After Me Comes a Man
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John steps back as Jesus moves forward.

cards.title: That He Might Be Revealed
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: The river becomes a line leading the crowd's gaze toward Jesus.

cards.title: The Spirit Descended and Remained
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John testifies as a dove-line rests above Jesus; immersion is not shown.

cards.title: He Baptizes with Holy Spirit
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John contrasts the river with one descending breath-line above Jesus.

cards.title: Son or Chosen One?
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: Two manuscript slips show the two deterministic Greek readings beside John's witness.

cards.title: John's Disciples Follow Jesus
cards.speaker: Narrator / John / Jesus
cards.visual: Two disciples leave John's side and walk after Jesus.

cards.title: Two Movements
cards.speaker: Narrator / John's disciples
cards.visual: Two distant river stations operate at the same time.

cards.title: He Must Increase
cards.speaker: John the Baptist
cards.visual: John's small lamp lowers while a larger light rises beyond him.

cards.title: The Burning and Shining Lamp
cards.speaker: Jesus
cards.visual: Jesus names John as a burning lamp; John appears only as the lamp's remembered silhouette.

cards.title: LOVE & LIGHT
cards.speaker: Editorial symbol
cards.visual: A radiant heart made from black line and one pale-gold light point; no attributed quotation.

cards.title: JESUS · A GESTURE OF LOVE
cards.speaker: Editorial symbol
cards.visual: Jesus makes a small finger-heart gesture; explicitly not presented as a Gospel event.
